title: TreeAI D2 evidence event (one JSONL line of an append-only journal)
description: One line of an events.jsonl file under evidence/d2/runs/<run-id>/, and the on-disk shape of the frozen contracts TreeAIEvent (packages/contracts/src/events.ts, CONTRACT-FREEZE-1 item 5). Invariants that JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by scripts/verify-d2: seq must start at 1 and be STRICTLY INCREASING per runId across lines, and payload must already be redacted (content-level secret scan). Known type values (open union per the frozen contract; unknown Pi events are recorded with their raw kind, never dropped): run.state-changed, run.abort-requested, run.steer-enqueued, agent.started, agent.settled, turn.started, turn.completed, message.started, message.updated, message.completed, tool.execution.started, tool.execution.finished, tool.decision, session.created, session.restored, session.replaced, tree.navigated, runtime.error, runtime.recovered, pi.unknown; verifier-added families: verify.run-started, verify.check-finished, verify.run-finished, live.scenario-started, live.scenario-finished. Revision policy: any breaking change to this schema requires a schemas/d2/README.md revision entry and new positive/negative probes under tests/fixtures/schema-probes/event/.

eventId.description: Opaque unique event id. Unique at least within one run's journal.

runId.description: The run this event belongs to. Cross-line rule: seq is strictly increasing per runId (enforced by the verifier, not by the schema).

seq.description: 1-based sequence number within the runId, strictly increasing, no duplicates. Continuity (no gaps) is recommended practice, not a hard requirement (frozen contract events.ts).

occurredAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp. The Z suffix is mandatory: non-UTC offsets are rejected.

type.description: Dot-notation event type (frozen contract TreeAIEventType, open union).

payload.description: Redacted JSON payload. Must already be free of credentials, Authorization/Cookie values, tokens and absolute user-home paths before it is written (content scan enforces; the schema only requires an object).

evidence.description: References to the raw records this event was derived from. May be empty for pure projection events (frozen contract).

source.description: Where the referenced raw record lives (frozen contract EvidenceReference).

refId.description: Identifier of the raw record (e.g. a PiRuntimeEvent.eventId value).

locator.description: Optional already-redacted locator (relative path/line). Must not contain secrets or absolute user-home paths.
